evals.prompt: Run the readiness scan on these stories.
evals.expected_output: Summary with buckets that add up to the total.
expectations: Ready + to refine + to split equals the total (4)
No story appears in two buckets
The large story with no AC appears in To refine, with the size as a note

evals.prompt: Are these stories ready to enter a sprint?
evals.expected_output: The story with no epic is not reported as ready.
expectations: The story with no epic does NOT appear in Ready
The missing epic is presented as a gap
The output states that the epic is required in the configuration used

evals.prompt: Our Kanban team does not use epics or estimates, but requires identified dependencies and testability.
evals.expected_output: Scan with the team's DoR, without penalising the absence of an epic or an estimate.
expectations: The absence of an epic is not treated as a gap
Stories without identified dependencies or that are not testable appear as gaps
The lack of an estimate is NOT treated as a gap
The Notes record the DoR criteria used and that estimation is optional in Kanban

evals.prompt: Check readiness and tell me whether the story descriptions have substance.
evals.expected_output: Clear distinction between the model's judgment and the script's aggregation.
expectations: The output makes explicit that the substance assessment is the model's
Does not attribute to the script the judgment of description or AC quality
Records the judgment criteria used

evals.prompt: Run the readiness scan on the top of the NAC backlog.
evals.expected_output: Empty-backlog warning instead of a normal-looking report of zero stories.
expectations: The report includes a prominent warning that zero stories came back
Does not conclude that the backlog is refined or healthy
Instructs to confirm the board and the JQL
The warning is carried over into the delivered shortlist

evals.prompt: Run the readiness scan on the top of the Kanban flow — the team does not use estimates.
evals.expected_output: Items with description and AC are ready even without a size; split only when a size is above the ceiling.
expectations: The story with no size but with description and AC appears in Ready
The absence of estimate/size is NOT a gap
The output states estimate/size required: no
The complete XL story appears in split candidates, not in To refine
